scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@family-expense-tracker/shared && node scripts/sync-functions-shared.mjs && npm run build --workspace=@family-expense-tracker/functions && npm run build --workspace=@family-expense-tracker/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@family-expense-tracker/shared && node scripts/sync-functions-shared.mjs && npm run typecheck --workspace=@family-expense-tracker/functions && npm run typecheck --workspace=@family-expense-tracker/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@family-expense-tracker/shared && node scripts/sync-functions-shared.mjs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.rules-test.json --only firestore "vitest run tests/rules"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --workspace=@family-expense-tracker/shared && node scripts/sync-functions-shared.mjs && npm run build --workspace=@family-expense-tracker/functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-family-expense-tracker --config firebase.e2e.json --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "playwright test"
scripts.emulators: npm run build --workspace=@family-expense-tracker/shared && node scripts/sync-functions-shared.mjs && npm run build --workspace=@family-expense-tracker/functions && firebase emulators:start
scripts.seed: npm run build --workspace=@family-expense-tracker/shared && node scripts/sync-functions-shared.mjs && FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8088 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-family-expense-tracker npm run seed --workspace=@family-expense-tracker/functions
